title: spec-ambiguity: fix_signal.skill.md Phase 3 patch instruction assumes absent fields but signal schema includes null-valued fields
description: The Phase 3 instruction says to 'locate the closing } and call patch_file with old_string set to the closing }' to add picked_up_at and fix_branch. However, the canonical signal schema includes these fields as null from the initial write. The agent must infer to update null-to-value rather than append absent fields, which is a non-obvious judgment call not covered by the skill.
proposed_resolution: Update fix_signal.skill.md Phase 3 to state: 'Set the picked_up_at field to the current ISO 8601 timestamp and fix_branch to the computed fix_branch value. Use patch_file to replace the null values, or write_file for the complete updated record if multiple fields change simultaneously.'
